videos.title: Our Holiday Story
videos.description: A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.

videos.title: Sense, Sensibility & Snowmen
videos.description: Christmas party planners Ella and her sister Marianne clash with client Edward, a not-so-jolly toy company CEO.

videos.title: A Wish for Christmas
videos.description: Sara prefers to be on the sidelines at work until someone steals her big idea for a Christmas initiative. She makes a wish to Santa to gain the courage to stand up for herself, and he gives her 48 hours to discover how to speak her own mind.

videos.title: A Very Merry Mix-Up
videos.description: A woman plans to meet her future in-laws at Christmas and, through a serendipitous series of events, spends the holiday with a warm and caring family whose son catches her eye.

videos.title: Crown for Christmas
videos.description: After getting fired from her job as a maid at a ritzy New York City hotel, a woman accepts a temporary job as governess to a young girl who is part of a powerful European family.

videos.title: A Royal Christmas
videos.description: The queen of Cordinia schemes to break up her royal son's romance with a seamstress from Philadelphia.

videos.title: Double Booked for the Holidays
videos.description: Twins Abigail and Charlie spend Christmas in Wales to run a bookstore and get swept into holiday romances with two Hay-on-Wye locals, a charming barista and a dashing lord.

videos.title: Return to Santa
videos.description: When Santa finds Jake's decades-old Christmas list, he decides to fast-track all the wishes, disrupting Jake's practical life and jeopardizing his reconnection with childhood best friend Julie.

videos.title: The Most Wonderful Secret
videos.description: An art teacher visiting family for Christmas starts receiving gifts from "Your Secret Norma." With the late Norma's son, she follows a scavenger hunt and finds love and purpose along the way.

videos.title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
videos.description: After a bad blind date, Lindsey and Philip both end up at Walt Disney World Resort, where a Christmas wish takes them from never ever to ever after.

videos.title: Santa Tell Me
videos.description: A design show host finds a letter from Santa promising to meet her true love, a man named Nick, by Christmas Eve. Meeting three Nicks complicates her search.

videos.title: Single on the 25th
videos.description: For Nell Duke, nothing is worse than being single during Christmastime as everywhere she looks, couples are kissing under the mistletoe. However, she soon makes a special connection with a neighbor who shows her how to keep the holidays festive.

videos.title: Mr. & Mrs. Christmas
videos.description: Single dad Taylor is inspired more than ever to give his two children the best Christmas in their new town. He leads the city's holiday event department, as new colleague Sophie supervises him.

videos.title: Small Town Christmas
videos.description: Nell's last stop on a nationwide book tour takes her to Springdale, the hometown of Emmett, a young man she met while both were junior copy editors at a New York publishing company.

videos.title: A Danish Christmas
videos.description: Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge, and the two find a connection as well.

videos.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
videos.description: Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game.

videos.title: Christmas Under the Lights
videos.description: Emily reluctantly returns home to her family's rescue ranch to organize the Christmas Carnival and works with a handsome artist to honor her mother.

videos.title: Adopting St. Nick
videos.description: After adopting a grandparent from a new retirement community for the holidays, Maren and her daughter Leah cross paths with the program's manager, Reid, and the suspiciously jolliest of residents.

videos.title: The Christmas Eve Feast
videos.description: Silvy heads home to Boston for Christmas to prepare the Feast of the Seven Fishes while her nonna recovers from an injury and is charmed by Ethan, a local photographer documenting the meal.

videos.title: Following Yonder Star
videos.description: A former television star waits out a scandal in Vermont. She becomes close with the innkeeper and his daughter while she helps him direct the local Christmas pageant.

videos.title: Eight Nights for Love
videos.description: This Hanukkah, a magical menorah shows Hannah that love has always been right in front of her in the form of her childhood best friend Ethan -- if only she's willing to take the risk.

videos.title: Miles to Christmas
videos.description: When a snowstorm wrecks their travel plans from Chicago to Tennessee, Cassidy and Jo must hitch a ride from Chase, Jo's trucker brother, to get home in time for Christmas morning.

videos.title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
videos.description: After a bad blind date, Lindsey and Philip both end up at Walt Disney World Resort, where a Christmas wish takes them from never ever to ever after.

videos.title: One Royal Holiday
videos.description: When Anna offers a stranded mother and son shelter from a blizzard, she learns that they are the royal family of Galwick and that they are both in need of a little Christmas magic.

videos.title: A Royal Montana Christmas
videos.description: Overwhelmed by her royal duties, Princess Victoria visits Big Sky Country for Christmas and meets her dashing guide at the ranch. She must decide if love is worth leaving her royal life behind.

videos.title: Christmas at Grand Valley
videos.description: Kelly returns to Grand Valley for Christmas. When Leo, a single dad, arrives in town with his kids to review a hotel, the two cross paths. As Kelly re-experiences traditions with Leo, she begins to find her way back to her passion for art.

videos.title: Write Before Christmas
videos.description: Jessica sends Christmas cards to five people who have greatly impacted her life, including the aunt who raised her, her brother, an aging pop star, the teacher that inspired her and her friend that always tells the truth.

videos.title: The Mistletoe Secret
videos.description: Aria hopes being selected for Sterling Masters' Big Holiday Adventure will save Christmas in Midway. Little does she know that Alex Bartlett is the voice behind Sterling Masters.

videos.title: Time for Him to Come Home for Christmas
videos.description: Four days before Christmas, Elizabeth Athens receives a voicemail from a number she doesn't recognize. On the message, a man she doesn't know makes one final plea for the love of his life to give him a second chance.

videos.title: Coyote Creek Christmas
videos.description: An event planner discovers Christmas magic with a charming father-son duo while throwing a themed Christmas party at her family's inn.

videos.title: Long Lost Christmas
videos.description: Hayley is an interior designer who plans to surprise her recently widowed mother with the perfect holiday present -- the extended family she knows her mom yearns for.

videos.title: Our Holiday Playbook
videos.description: To help her father win their annual flag football game, Lexi convinces Eddie to join the team as her pretend boyfriend in exchange for coaching him through his family baking contest.

videos.title: Miles to Christmas
videos.description: When a snowstorm wrecks their travel plans from Chicago to Tennessee, Cassidy and Jo must hitch a ride from Chase, Jo's trucker brother, to get home in time for Christmas morning.

videos.title: The Most Wonderful Secret
videos.description: An art teacher visiting family for Christmas starts receiving gifts from "Your Secret Norma." With the late Norma's son, she follows a scavenger hunt and finds love and purpose along the way.

videos.title: A Christmas Together With You
videos.description: Planning on spending the holidays alone, Megan and her father figure, Frank, go on a road trip to find his first true love.

videos.title: She's Making a List
videos.description: A woman unexpectedly falls for a widowed father while evaluating if his 11-year-old daughter should be on Santa's naughty or nice list.
